$comment: Completion bar for #139: first-run sample notes are seeded into a single 'Getting started' project (rewritten as a guided tour, spanning PARA groups), their ids are recorded so a one-click 'Remove samples' action deletes them together, and removal persists across restarts (no re-seed). db.ts seeds via SAMPLE_NOTES_PROJECT and exposes listSampleNotes/removeSampleNotes; the renderer shows the Remove samples rail action while samples exist.
